messages:
omar: FYI seeing a slow uptick in 5xx from hosted-eu (~02:30 UTC). p50 latency climbing, and a few customer timeouts reported.

lina: thanks — any correlated deploys or config changes?

omar: none in deploy log. posting api-gateway logs sample:

omar: ```
2026-03-18T02:34:12Z gateway error backend 502 target=runtime-1: connection reset
2026-03-18T02:35:07Z gateway error upstream_timeout seq=0 req_id=abc123
```

kevin: can you repro with curl? customer said they saw ~30% failed requests at P50

omar: quick curl:

omar: `curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'`

maria: i'm seeing auth proxy latencies spike around same timeframe, maybe token refresh storms

sre-bot: alert: hosted-eu gateway 5xx rate > 10% for 15m, autoscaling triggered

lina: check kv-cache hitrate? If cache misses skyrocket, backend load spikes.

kevin: checking kvcache metrics now — miss rate jumped from 5%->48% at 02:29

omar: that matches. customers using long-context endpoints experienced timeouts.

support-agent: opened customer ticket #C-3245, notified account team. customer asked for ETA.

maria: mitigation — rolling restart of auth-proxy in eu-west bumped 200 responses back up; performed canary 02:47

kevin: created patch to add jitter to token refresh (PR #1824). will backport to prod.

lina: action items: 1) backfill kvcache warmup for long-tail tenants 2) telemetry alert for sudden kvmiss increases 3) add auth refresh backoff + jitter 4) customer comms + credits evaluation

omar: adding runbook notes and reproduce steps in wiki: steps to repro: 1) simulate high token refresh by hammering /auth/refresh 2) scale down kvcache warmers 3) fire long-sequence requests

support-agent: customer update sent: "we mitigated, root cause auth refresh storm + kvcache miss. follow-up planned." :thumbsup: 

kevin: scheduling postmortem meeting tomorrow 09:00 UTC. assigning owners: kvcache=lina, auth=maria, comms=omar

maria: one more metric to track: per-tenant rolling kvcache miss over 5m window

lina: PRs: #1824 (auth jitter), #1827 (kvcache warmup). Target deploy in next maintenance window.

omar: thanks team — closing war room for now. will reopen if spike recurs.
